citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
The licensee did not provide access to a copy of the Program of Veterinary Care (PVC). The licensee stated that the PVC
was not on site and was otherwise inaccessible at the time of inspection. The PVC was reviewed and acceptable at the
last inspection on June 4, 2026. A water buffalo was acquired since the last inspection. Changes to the PVC to include
this new species could not be evaluated. Failure to establish and maintain a Program of Veterinary Care may compromise
animal welfare. The PVC must be properly maintained and available for review at the time of inspection. To be corrected
by September 10, 2026.

The licensee did not provide access to acquisition or disposition records. The licensee stated that acquisition and
disposition records were not on site and were inaccessible at the time of inspection. The licensee stated that a kangaroo
and two alpacas were sold and a water buffalo was acquired since the last inspection. Appropriate documentation of
acquisition and disposition of regulated animals is essential for proper identification and necessary to track animals used
in regulated activities to ensure their humane care, use, and disposition. Every dealer shall make, keep and maintain
records of acquisition and disposition for all regulated animals, including animals born on the premises. These records
must be available for review at the time of inspection. To be corrected by September 10, 2026.

The licensee did not provide access to a copy of the contingency plan. The licensee stated that the contingency plan was
not on site and was otherwise inaccessible at the time of inspection. The contingency plan was reviewed and acceptable
at the time of the last inspection on June 4, 2026. The written contingency plan ensures instructions for personnel are
available and animal welfare is maintained in the event of an emergency. Contingency plans, as well as all annual review
documentation, must be made available to APHIS upon request. To be corrected by September 10, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
